title: Design System: Workspace OS — The Infinite Desk

body.purpose: The work — lists, rows, buttons, nav items.

headline.purpose: Section titles on dashboards and forms.

shadows.name: nav-active
shadows.purpose: The single selected nav row; light tonal lift.

shadows.name: hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Blue-tinted glow on primary actions at hover.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, search results, anything lifted above the desk.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Standard easing for mounts and state transitions; 150-350ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one glowing action on the desk — blue fill, white text, blue-tinted glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; font: 500 14px/1.5 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-out, opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(37 99 235 / 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action — hairline edge-slate stroke, mist text that brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #94a3b8; font: 500 14px/1.5 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 8px; transition: color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Deep-ink field with a slate seam that shifts to a calm blue stroke on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #020617; color: #f1f5f9; font: 400 12px/1.4 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #1e293b; border-radius: 8px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgb(59 130 246 / 0.5); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar row — mist at rest, half-fill on hover, raised slate + white text + soft blue icon when active.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #94a3b8; font: 400 14px/1.5 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav:hover { background: rgb(30 41 59 / 0.5); color: #e2e8f0; } .ds-nav-active { background: #1e293b; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-nav-active svg { color: #60a5fa; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Ink-panel container with a hairline seam — flat at rest, blue-tinted shadow only when interactive and hovered.
components.css: .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #0f172a, rgb(15 23 42 / 0.6)); border: 1px solid rgb(30 41 59 / 0.5); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-interactive { transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-card-interactive:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Signature hero/auth surface — the one place blur is allowed: gradient, frost, deep shadow, drifting primary blobs.
components.css: .ds-glass { background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #0f172a, rgb(15 23 42 / 0.6)); border: 1px solid rgb(30 41 59 / 0.5); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; backdrop-filter: blur(24px); box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); }

components.name: Unread Badge
components.description: Solid signal-red pill with 10px bold white count.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ef4444; color: #ffffff; font: 700 10px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Full-pill slate-gradient initials chip — 28px in the sidebar footer, 20px in workspace lists.
components.css: .ds-avatar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #475569, #334155); color: #e2e8f0; font: 500 12px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Logo Mark
components.description: 28px square, 6px corners, primary gradient, blue-tinted shadow — the only place a full blue gradient lives.
components.css: .ds-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #3b82f6, #1d4ed8); color: #ffffff; font: 700 12px/1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(37 99 235 / 0.3); }

narrative.overview:
The canvas is the product. Workspace OS is a real-time collaboration surface, and the UI behaves like a well-kept desk in a dark studio: everything needed is within reach, the lighting is dim so the work stands out, and nothing on the desk competes with the paper you're drawing on. The interface is a quiet instrument tuned for focus — dark ink surfaces recede, the instrument-blue accent marks only the active moment, and depth appears when you reach for something, not at rest.

The aesthetic is calm and precise: deep slate-ink panels layered tonally, hairline borders at the seams, and a single cool blue that reads as signal rather than personality. Density is compact but airy — 12px body text for meta, 14px for work, generous 8px radii on controls, 12-16px on containers. Motion is quick and utilitarian (150-350ms ease-out); nothing bounces, everything settles. This is an instrument, not a toy.

Confirmed visual rejections: no candy/neon dark mode, no purple or multi-hue gradients, no glassmorphism on every surface (frosted blur is reserved for hero/auth panels), no playful animation.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first ink surfaces (surface-950 page, surface-900 panels, surface-800 raised) with hairline slate borders
Single instrument-blue accent (primary-600/500/400) for actions, focus, active state, and the logo mark
Flat at rest, quiet glow on interaction — shadows and glows are responses, not decorations
Tonal layering as the default depth mechanism; shadows only for float and hover
8px control radius, 12-16px container radius, full pills for avatars/badges
Geist sans throughout; 10px uppercase tracking-wider labels for section headers
Quick utilitarian motion: 0.2-0.35s ease-out mounts, infinite shimmer for skeletons, border glow for scanning states

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue is reserved for the active moment: actions, focus, selection, and the logo. Resting surfaces are ink and slate only — a screen with blue everywhere has lost its signal.

rules.name: The Compact Rule
rules.body: Work text is 12-14px. 16px+ is reserved for titles and headings — the desk stays dense so the canvas gets the space.

rules.name: The Quiet-Reactive Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows and glows are state responses — they appear on hover, focus, and lift, and they disappear when the moment passes. If a resting card needs depth, layer a tone, not a shadow.

dos: Start every page from the deep-ink backdrop (surface-950) and build hierarchy with tonal layering (900 to 800).
Reserve blue for actions, focus strokes, active rows, and the logo mark — use primary-600 as the default action fill.
Use 8px corners on controls, 12px on cards, 16px on hero panels, and full pills for badges and avatars.
Use 10px uppercase tracking-wider steel text for section headers and 12px mist for meta.
Keep resting surfaces flat — reach for the blue-tinted hover glow only on interactive elements.
Keep motion between 150-350ms with ease-out; use shimmer (1.5s infinite) for skeletons and borderGlow for scanning states.
Treat the glass panel (gradient + blur + primary blobs) as an auth/hero-only pattern.
donts: Add shadows to resting cards — layer a tone instead.
Use blue as a text color for body copy; text accents stay at primary-300/400 and only for icons or emphasis.
Introduce a second accent hue, purple gradients, or neon — the system is instrument-blue over ink.
Blur working cards; backdrop blur belongs to the hero glass only.
Exceed 16px for content text; hierarchy beyond that belongs to titles and headings.
Add bouncy or elastic easing; motion settles, it never springs.
